title: Member Disclosure: The Autopay Discount and the Loan's Payment Record — Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When a member authorises automatic debit on a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the autopay discount follows the loan's record over the last 24 months: with no late charge assessed and no default-rate interest entry in that time it is 0.15 percentage points; with a default-rate interest entry in that time, or with two or more late charges assessed in it, it is 0.05 percentage points; otherwise it is the product's autopay discount.

**What is counted.** Late charges assessed on the loan (fee entries marked as a late charge) and default-rate interest entries (interest entries marked as default-rate interest), each dated in the last 24 months, as they stand on the loan's transaction history.

## Every combination

| Late charges assessed in the last 24 months | Default-rate interest entries in the last 24 months | Autopay discount (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 0.15 |
| exactly one | none | the product's autopay discount |
| two or more | none | 0.05 |
| none | one or more | 0.05 |
| exactly one | one or more | 0.05 |
| two or more | one or more | 0.05 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical records)

- A loan whose only blemish is one late charge assessed 30 months ago: nothing falls in the last 24 months, so the discount is 0.15.
- A loan with one late charge assessed 5 months ago and nothing else: the product's autopay discount.
- A loan with no late charge but one default-rate interest entry dated 11 months ago: 0.05.
